_comment: Reference only — shows what to put in the steward-session/prod Secrets Manager secret (as a single JSON-string secret, not individual key/value secrets). Not real values. Only the genuinely sensitive Redshift credentials belong here — Bedrock auth comes from the instance's IAM role, everything else (region, model id, vault path) is non-sensitive and lives in the .env that deploy/user-data.sh writes on the instance.
